script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Daily Buzz

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

JENNA, a perky barista, prepares an espresso for RACHEL, a regular customer. They share a friendly banter.

JENNA: (smiling)
Another day, another dollar, right?

RACHEL: (laughs)
Something like that. Just trying to make it through Monday.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

JOE, a stressed-out sales manager, huddles over his desk with a stack of papers. He hears laughter from the bullpen. He looks up and sees KAREN, a cheerful receptionist, chatting with RACHEL.

JOE: (sighs)
Why can't I have that kind of energy in the morning?

INT. BULLPEN - DAY

RACHEL shows KAREN a picture of her new puppy. Everyone gathers around to coo and make "awww" sounds.

JENNA: (entering)
Morning, everyone! Who's got the coffee?

They all laugh and point to RACHEL. She happily hands over the cup, earning more praise and thanks.

INT. SALES FLOOR - DAY

Joe calls for a sales meeting. Everyone gathers around as he paces back and forth, going over the monthly sales report. The atmosphere is tense.

JOE: (angrily)
We're down 10% this month! I expect everyone to step up their game!

Muffled whispers and concerned glances pass between the employees.

INT. BREAK ROOM - LUNCH

Jenna sits with Rachel, sharing a sandwich. Rachel looks visibly upset.

RACHEL: I've been thinking about quitting.

JENNA: (surprised)
What? Why?

RACHEL: (sighs)
I just can't take the pressure anymore. Joe's expectations are unrealistic.

JENNA: (comfortingly)
You're not alone in that feeling. Maybe we should talk to the HR department about it?

RACHEL: (shakes head)
No, I don't want to make a scene. I'll find another job.

INT. OFFICE - EVENING

Joe sits in his office, staring at a photo of his family. He looks exhausted and dejected.

INT. BULLPEN - EVENING

Jenna gathers the employees for a surprise birthday party for Karen. Joe is taken aback by the unity and kindness shown towards one of their own.

JENNA: (smiling)
We're a team here. And no matter what, we'll get through it together.

The room fills with laughter and smiles, and Joe can't help but feel a renewed sense of hope.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Jenna hands Rachel a free coffee as she leaves work.

JENNA: You deserve a little pick-me-up.

RACHEL: (smiling)
Thanks, Jenna. You're a good friend.

Jenna watches as Rachel walks off, feeling content that she's able to make a difference in someone's day.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
